idea-plugin.name: Pi Terminal Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Terminal Bridge

This plugin does not try to be an AI IDE. It does one thing: in the JetBrains IDE you already live in, compose prompts with enough context — then send them to Pi and watch the result in a real terminal.

Many developers still care about architecture and clean code. They want prompts that name the class, the method, the call site — so the agent edits the right place and stays in bounds. JetBrains' index, Go to Declaration, Find Usages, and Go to Implementation are exactly the tools they already use to gather that context. This plugin is the last mile: keep those clues in a prompt, send them to Pi, see the TUI respond.

It is not a vibe-coding cockpit. It is for people who want more control over, and participation in, how the agent changes their code. Session lists, live badges, drag-and-drop and notifications are icing.

Important: Install the Pi CLI separately before using this plugin.
npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent or visit pi.dev
Windows: use PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) as the IDE Terminal shell (Settings → Tools → Terminal → Shell path). cmd.exe is not supported for the live bridge.

What you get

  • Persistent conversations — sessions survive IDE restarts; click to relaunch and resume. Terminals are not auto-revived on startup.
  • Live bridge — working/idle badges, current model, and session switches (/new, /fork, /resume) reflected in the IDE panel in real time; old sessions archived and resumable
  • One-click launch from the toolbar in a dedicated Terminal tab
  • Send to Pi — select code, right-click, and send a file reference (@path/file.go#L10-25) to Pi's input. The panel input also has a context menu and accepts files dropped from the Project view.
  • Immediate VFS refresh when Pi writes a file — no waiting on the IDE's ~10s disk poll; optionally also open the file
  • Fork / Rewind on every message card — Fork starts a new conversation at that message: history up to and including the message and its full reply is kept, everything after is dropped, and the input stays empty. Rewind stays in the same session and moves the branch back to before that message (pi's /tree), pre-filling the panel input with its text for re-sending. The two are deliberately different.
  • Notifications — optional balloon when the agent finishes (only while the IDE is in the background; click to focus that terminal)
  • Flexible configuration for models, thinking levels, and launch options

Quick start

  1. Click the pi button in the main toolbar (or press Ctrl+Shift+P).
  2. A new Pi tab opens in the Terminal window and runs pi automatically.
  3. Select code, right-click, then Send to Pi to add file context to your prompt.
  4. Close and reopen the IDE — conversations are listed in the Pi panel and resume on click.

Open Settings → Tools → Pi Terminal Bridge to pick the model, thinking level, launch options, and bridge features.

Keyboard shortcuts

  • Ctrl+Shift+P — Open the Pi conversation window
  • Alt+Shift+3 — Send selection / file to Pi
  • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T — Focus the Pi terminal (only while the prompt is focused)
  • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E — Focus the Pi prompt (only while a Pi terminal is focused)

Both are rebindable in Settings → Keymap → Pi Terminal Bridge.

Supported IDEs

Works with all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, and more.

Pi Terminal Bridge（pi 终端桥）

这不是一个「AI IDE」。它真正做的事只有一件： 在你已经熟悉的 JetBrains IDE 里，把带充分上下文线索的提示词编排好， 发给 Pi，立刻在真实终端里看到结果。

不少人仍然在意架构层次和代码整洁，希望提示词能精确到类 / 方法， 让 AI 改得更准、把修改约束在该改的范围里。 JetBrains 的代码索引、方法跳转、引用查找、查看实现， 正是资深程序员早就习惯用来组织这种上下文的方式。 这个插件补上最后一公里：把这些线索收进 prompt，发给 Pi，看它干活。

它不适合完全 vibe 开发；更适合希望对 AI coding 过程有更多掌控力和参与感的场景。 会话列表、状态徽标、拖放和通知都只是锦上添花。

前置条件：使用本插件前请单独安装 Pi CLI。
npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 或访问 pi.dev
Windows：建议将 IDE 终端 Shell 设为 PowerShell 7（pwsh.exe） （Settings → Tools → Terminal → Shell path）。cmd.exe 无法用于实时桥接。

还能做什么

  • 持久会话 —— 会话跨 IDE 重启保留；点击即可重新拉起并恢复。启动时不会批量复活终端。
  • 实时桥接 —— working/idle 徽标、当前模型，以及终端内 /new、/fork、/resume 换绑都会同步到 IDE 面板；旧会话归档后仍可恢复
  • 一键启动 —— 工具栏按钮在 Terminal 工具窗中打开专属 Pi 标签页
  • 发送到 Pi —— 选中代码，右键发送文件引用（@path/file.go#L10-25）到 Pi 输入栏。面板输入栏也有右键菜单，并接受从 Project 视图拖入的文件。
  • Pi 写完立刻刷新 —— 不等 IDEA 大约 10 秒的磁盘轮询；也可选打开该文件
  • Fork / Rewind —— 每条用户消息卡片都有两个按钮，语义刻意不同：Fork 新开一个会话，保留到该消息（含该轮完整回复）为止，其后历史全部丢弃，输入框留空；Rewind 不换会话，把当前会话的活跃分支退到该消息之前（对应 pi 的 /tree），仅把该消息文本预填到面板输入框供修改重发。
  • 通知 —— 可选：agent 结束时气泡提醒（仅 IDE 在后台时弹出；点击可定位到对应终端）
  • 灵活配置 —— 模型、thinking 级别与启动参数

快速上手

  1. 点击主工具栏的 pi 按钮（或按 Ctrl+Shift+P）。
  2. Terminal 工具窗中打开专属 Pi 标签页，自动运行 pi。
  3. 选中代码，右键 → Send to Pi，把文件上下文加入提示。
  4. 关闭并重开 IDE —— 面板中列出全部会话，点击即可恢复。

打开 Settings → Tools → Pi Terminal Bridge 可选择模型、thinking 级别、启动选项和桥接功能。

快捷键

  • Ctrl+Shift+P —— 打开 Pi 会话窗口
  • Alt+Shift+3 —— 发送选中内容 / 文件到 Pi
  • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T —— 焦点到 Pi 终端（仅在 prompt 输入框内生效）
  • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E —— 焦点到 Pi prompt（仅在 Pi 终端内生效）

均可在 Settings → Keymap → Pi Terminal Bridge 中修改。

支持的 IDE

适用于所有 JetBrains IDE：IntelliJ IDEA、GoLand、PyCharm、WebStorm、PhpStorm、CLion、Rider、RubyMine 等。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.6

  • Fix: the panel now shows the current model. The bridge extension read a non-existent modelId field from pi's model_select event; it now reads the Model object (provider/id) and also reports the current model on session start, matching pi 1.4.
  • Fix: finish notifications include the error/abort reason. agent_settled only carries aborted; the extension now uses that flag and the final assistant message's stopReason, so the balloon can say “aborted” or “stopped with an error” again.

0.3.5

  • Fork a conversation at any message. Each user-message card has a Fork button (branch icon): it creates a new conversation named <original>-fork that keeps the history up to and including that message and its complete reply — tool calls/results included — and drops everything after it. The panel input stays empty, so you continue from exactly that point in a fresh session; the original conversation is untouched. This is intentionally not pi's default /fork (edit-before): the message you forked on stays in history.
  • Rewind within the current session. The Rewind button (undo icon) is the in-session variant of pi's /tree: it moves the session branch back to before that message — no new session, no terminal restart — so the message itself and everything after it drop out of the model context, and the message text is pre-filled in the panel input for re-sending. Tree entries stay in the session file, like /tree. Fork and Rewind are kept distinct on purpose.
  • Immediate VFS refresh while Pi is still working. Files written by Pi's edit/write tools sync in the IDE right after each tool result, instead of waiting for the ~10s disk poll; optionally the file is also opened in the editor.
  • Message-card actions ordered rewind / fork / copy / delete with smaller icon buttons and a proper trash icon; the delete tooltip clarifies it only removes the panel card, not the Pi session.

0.3.3

  • Fix: resume now finds the right session file. The plugin previously passed the parent sessions directory, so --session <id> failed with No session found matching. It now locates pi's real per-project folder and passes the full .jsonl path on resume.
  • Stop forcing --session-dir: new sessions follow pi's own configuration (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, sessionDir, or the default per-project path), so custom layouts keep working; if the scan misses, --session-id lets pi resolve or create.
  • Windows: PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) is recommended as the IDE Terminal shell; cmd.exe is explicitly unsupported for the live bridge.
  • Conversation dropdown: the delete button keeps the popup open and highlights on hover, so closed sessions can be deleted in a batch.
  • Send to Pi appends file references again (no more same-path replacement).
  • README / Marketplace description now lead with why the plugin exists: compose grounded prompts in the IDE and send them to Pi — not a vibe-coding cockpit.

0.3.2

  • Finish notifications fire only when the IDE is in the background; click the balloon to focus that terminal
  • Status bar shows how many conversations are working
  • Panel input: context menu and drag-and-drop files as @path refs
  • Clear warnings when Extra arguments conflict with session flags, or when the Windows Terminal shell is cmd.exe
  • Tool window / notification group renamed to Pi Bridge
  • Fix: restore-terminal no longer calls Terminal getShellPath on the EDT

0.3.1

  • New identity: renamed to Pi Terminal Bridge (com.piterminal.bridge); fresh start, earlier 0.x releases belong to the original pi-agent-launcher project
  • Persistent conversations: sessions survive IDE restarts, click to relaunch and resume
  • Live IDEA-pi bridge: working/idle badges, model display, session rebind on /new//fork with old session archived
  • Settings: agent-finish notifications and auto-open modified files (both opt-in)
